description: Sends a one-off test delivery to a registered webhook (rate-limited to 10/min), confirming it is wired up correctly before a real match arrives. The test payload is formatted by the webhook's `kind`, the same way a real delivery would be. On failure the response carries `reason` and `status`, plus `hint`, a sentence naming the fix (most often that the target's `kind` does not match its host, which no test can succeed through), and `detail`, a bounded, sanitised copy of what the destination itself replied. `hint` carries the remedy; a bare `reason` such as `http_error` with a 400 names no field, no value and no remedy. Returns 404 `webhook_not_found` if the id does not exist or is not on this account, or `webhook_url_rejected` if the URL fails re-validation (e.g. now resolves to a private address).

id.description: The webhook's id, as returned when the webhook was created or listed.

name: reddit_monitor_webhook_test
